title: Revengeance, Part Circle

html:
Quest Giver: [GoS] Leda Beaurde

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Search through Level 2 of the Shadow's Embrace for Halfassin Black. Once you find him, kill him before he kills you. Ask [GoS] Leda Beaurde in the Shadow's Gate to track the kill.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: [GoS] Leda Beaurde

Repeatable: No

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Search through Level 2 of the Shadow's Embrace for Halfassin Black. Once you find him, kill him before he kills you. Ask [GoS] Leda Beaurde in the Shadow's Gate to track the kill.

Offer:

Have you seen him!? I think he's gone by now...but you never know! I bet he is on level 2. Go finish him off for me.

Who? Why, Halfassin Black, of course! That cheater snuck up on me. When you are done with him, go tell Leda Beaurde in the Shadow's Embrace--look around for her, she is probably hiding somewhere. But don't be a kill-stealer...*I* want the credit for the kill!

Turn-in:

You must be very skilled if you can see me here. What do you want from me?

A Halfassin wants me to track his kills? No...I only do Guild of Shadows work. Those Halfassins aren't worth my time-they're not part of the Guild of Shadows. They're just a bunch of wanna-be's that never-will. But, I'll tell you what...maybe *this* Halfassin has what it takes. I'll make a mental note of his kill. If he turns out to be something special, I'll split his GoS recruitment bonus with you.

Objectives:

  • Kill Halfassin Black

Client level range: 45–100
